role: Post-hoc, blinded sensitivity audit of the published 96-page subscriptions. Does the direction of a quality difference survive reasonable factual equivalence rather than exact wording? The primary endpoints remain the registered exact match and F1. No inference policy can be changed from this audit.
cases: For each page take the union of distinct answers from full versus guarded reuse for 9B (with and without checkpoints) and for the direct CPU reader. Collapse case and whitespace only. Automatically accept a literal match to the official current answer after case and external whitespace normalization. Individually inspect every other distinct answer, including answers shared by the two methods. Sort blind entries by content hash and hide policy, cost and model. Use the question, current official reference and actual current service passage; the reference defines the scoring date.
rubric: Accept an answer that conveys the requested current fact and all explicitly requested components. Accept equivalent numbers, names, order, paraphrases and omission of redundant wording. Reject an earlier or contradictory value, a different entity, unsupported specificity or a missing explicitly requested component. If source/reference are incompatible or alias equivalence genuinely cannot be determined, mark uncertain and report both bounds. No internet lookup or new model answers. One AI editorial adjudicator, no human labels. Scores describe this workload only.
